intent: Couple the airframe, six-channel ESC, motor limits, stock nesting, and low/high-speed control effectors without changing the selected powertrain.

powertrain.escBurstDuration: unvalidated; do not budget as available continuous power
powertrain.escBusSoftPowerLimitBasis: inherited Phase-9 six-channel, 330A, 30mOhm pack sensitivity screen

alternativeMotorTradeScreen.recommendation: retain FA4119 until a smaller EDF motor demonstrates the exact operating map
alternativeMotorTradeScreen.candidateClass: 12S EDF-rated high-speed brushless motor, 35-40mm stator OD, <=0.25kg each
alternativeMotorTradeScreen.ratingBasis: system bus-input share from Phase-14 calibrated analytical screen; shaft rating must be derived from measured motor/ESC/gear efficiency
alternativeMotorTradeScreen.purchaseGate: manufacturer continuous EDF cooling data or guarded dynamometer map at 12S, target RPM, current and thermal limits

airframe.architecture: slender carbon-fibre-wrapped PLA lifting body with two coaxially projected 90mm EDF modules and split exit flow through a four-vane thrust-vectoring ring

frontalAreaModel.note: The 150x150 ESC and 140x100 flight boards set the minimum internal bay volume, not the external silhouette. The external frontal silhouette is battery/body dominated and saturates below roughly an 80 mm fan diameter, so shrinking the fan past that point does not reduce CdA.

airframe.airframeMaterial: printed PLA core, carbon-fibre wrap, high-temperature epoxy system, local glass isolation ply at metal edges

massBudget.note: Phase-13 estimate excludes the newly specified six control actuators and vector-vane details; all additions and measured mass growth must fit under the Phase-14 8.5kg cap.

fixedPackaging.batteryPackEnvelopeSource: SpeedyFPV Turnigy Rapid 6S5000 listing: 136x44x64mm; Phase-13 CAD used a 150x50x45mm package proxy
fixedPackaging.note: These fixed envelopes prevent whole-airframe mass from scaling with EDF diameter. ESC saved PCB is six-layer while the reference architecture document still states four-layer. Refit battery envelopes in CAD before release.

stock.stockAllocation: six rotor hubs from the 16mm bar; 72 rotor blades plus 126 stator vanes nested in the two 5mm sheets; stator rails are integrated into the composite duct structure

control.authorityMetric: available control moment divided by trim-plus-disturbance demanded control moment
control.actuatorPower: dedicated regulated high-current rail sized from selected actuator stall current; not the ESC flight-board 5V auxiliary rail
control.vectoringRole: four independently actuated vanes in the split EDF exit provide propwash control as airspeed approaches zero; paired elevons add aerodynamic authority as dynamic pressure builds

lowSpeedFlowConcept.bypassEvidenceLimit: Phase-2 reduced-order cycle sweep at CdA=0.00315m2; separate ideal nozzles; no static point, fan map, variable-area kinematics, or measured pressure recovery
lowSpeedFlowConcept.auxiliaryInletScheduleConcept: open extra side area from static through 180kmh; close/fair flush above low-speed transition to protect high-speed CdA
lowSpeedFlowConcept.nozzleAndBypassScheduleStatus: concept only; current Phase-13 CAD does not model actuated area schedule

doNotClaim: verified strong or medium control authority
measured CdA or installed pressure recovery
verified variable-bypass or auxiliary-inlet thrust gain
